items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: He played with Fiorito. Yeah, Ted Fiorito.

ctx.x: A lot of the Mexican boys don't trumpet around there. I could have got any of them going on my face. And the man wanted to ban there on Saturday night.

I forget, man. He didn't care about the other night, see. Yeah. But he wanted to ban there on Saturday night. I forget to do that. No, man. I'm saying, ain't this something. That was the third time. And I mean, eight times. Batsy, now this the limit. Now George told me, he said, now listen, William. Now this the last straw. Nah, that's your job when you take me back. I'm going to get rid of you. I said, now Batsy, I told you that. See that? He said, now we've been together five years. He never had given no…

Yeah, but he got busted down for two years for marijuana. Yeah. See, he didn't want to wet gate, but he'd done something wrong in the night. He caught him with it up in the hotel room. Him and a bunch of them.
